Directions: Use the information to answer each question that follows.
Content: Students watched their teacher drop an antacid into a bottle of water and mix the substances. A balloon was placed onto the opening of the bottle. The students noticed that after the substances were mixed, bubbles were present in the water and the balloon filled up so that it became bigger. The diagram shows what the students observed.
The students wonder why this happened and decide to mix different substances to investigate. The teacher gives the students several substances for their investigation:

:ibox:• An antacid (a white solid)
• Water (a clear liquid)
• Lemon juice (a light yellow liquid)
• Salt (a white solid)
The students make `text(three)` different mixtures using these substances and record their observations in a table.
